title: Fantasy Leagues
description: Create a fantasy league on an event, price its players, and open it to fans.
loadFailed: The leagues could not be loaded.
explainer: A league goes draft, then priced, then open. It cannot be opened before its players are priced, because an open league with no prices shows fans an empty squad builder. Once it opens, the rules of the game are frozen: every squad already entered was built against them.
empty: No fantasy leagues yet. Create one on an event that has a registered roster.

create.title: Create a fantasy league
create.description: These settings are frozen once the league opens, because every squad entered is built against them. Everything else can be edited later.
create.eventIdHint: The AFC event this league runs on. Its registered players become the pool.
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: Left blank, it is named after the event.
create.squadSizeHint: 4 to 6. Five is recommended: a Free Fire squad is four, so four would let somebody copy one real team.
create.maxPerTeamHint: The setting that stops everyone entering the same squad. Two is recommended.
create.captainHint: In tenths: 20 is 2x. Three times makes the captain almost the whole game.
create.budgetHint: The pot each fan gets. 100 keeps prices easy to read at a glance.
create.teamPremiumHint: How much playing for a strong team adds to a player's price, ranked on the team's actual finishes. Set 0 to price purely on the individual.
create.done: League created as a draft. Price the players next.
create.failed: The league could not be created.
